data.name: Lingering Evocations
data.description: Any evocation spell you cast with a duration greater than instantaneous lasts an additional %1 rounds. At 20th level, any dispel checks made against your evocation spells must be rolled twice, and your opponent must use the less favorable result.|GenerationLingeringEvocations
